Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly identified King Edward VII as the King responsible for the 1925 Birthday Honours. King Edward VII died in 1910, well before 1925, making it impossible for him to have issued the 1925 Birthday Honours. The mistake likely arose from misinterpreting the initial search results from WebSurfer, as there was no verification of the claim that Edward VII was responsible. The Planner failed to notice this anachronism and proceeded with this incorrect information, leading to the wrong final answer. 

The correct King responsible for the 1925 Birthday Honours would likely have been King George V, who was the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom at the time.
